LanguageTool Offline uses the engine, English grammar rules, and dictionaries bundled with this app. Text stays on your device. No account, server, or download is needed.

English (US and UK) is supported. Hosted AI and large n-gram models are not included.

LanguageTool is available under LGPL 2.1 or later; dictionaries and dependencies have their own licenses. Source: https://github.com/fraej/languagetool
